Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's inherited effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect, does that [On Play] effect activate when the Digimon enters play?

Effect: ＜Digisorption -3＞ (When this card in the hand would be digivolved into, by suspending 1 of your Digimon, reduce the cost by 3.)
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] You may play 1 level 3 green Digimon card from your hand suspended without paying the cost.
